Name: (CP) Buy Unique Furniture From Qi's Casino Redux
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
I could have probably just made a new mod and called it something else. I really like the idea and doing a Redux is a great way to give nods to those who came before. I also thought their cover image was hilarious and wanted to use it.

[color=#ff00ff]Taken from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9176?tab=description]Original Mod[/url] page.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]"[/color]Gunther gives out some lovely furniture items and decorations in return for donating items to the museum, but you can only ever have just one of most of them! What if you want 'Jade Hills' in your shed [i]and[/i] your farmhouse? How about a singing stone or bear statue on both sides of a room? And, really, what is one supposed to do with only [i]one[/i] crystal chair?

[color=#ff00ff][b]This mod adds most of Stardew Valley's pesky one-of-a-kind furniture items to the casino shop in Calico Desert.[/b]
[b]They will only be available for sale once the original has been found by whatever means it is found in vanilla.[/b][/color] (The exception to this is the 'Boat' painting, as it is entirely unobtainable outside of the Beach farm type.)
All of these items cost casino coins, with prices balanced around the vanilla casino offerings. All of the vanilla casino items are still available! However, 'Burnt Offering' will not be available until the original has been obtained as a museum reward, to match all of the new stock added by this mod.

[b][color=#ff00ff]Why Qi's Casino?[/color]
[/b]Qi's Casino already sells the 'Burnt Offering' museum reward, so I thought it was a fitting place to add the rest. The casino also doesn't have much of a reason to go there in vanilla outside of alien rarecrows, so this gives it more of a purpose.~[color=#ff00ff]"[/color]

[color=#ffff00]We made a few changes[/color], like not gating the burnt offering vanilla behavior and adding some items the original mod intentionally left out. We also [color=#00ff00]ADDED[/color] a lot of content and several [color=#783f04]GMCM Options[/color].
